scoring_justification: Scored artifacts are the final wrinkling analysis and contact stiffness; the verifier cannot recompute stiffness from raw force data, so it compares the reported values to paper gold within tolerance and enforces structural trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference contact stiffness values and wrinkle wavelength range
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.5(a) and text: concave-zigzag 189 N/m, convex-armchair 42 N/m; remaining values are consistent with the reference simulation and paper trends.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Collected from the paper and the hidden reference solution solve.sh which embodies the correct MD reproduction.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly traceable to the paper-reported data for the same system conditions (R=5 nm, T=300 K, v=10 m/s). The reference solve.sh is the oracle for a correct reproduction, not an arbitrary choice.

outputs.description: Wrinkle analysis results for curved armchair and zigzag GNRs at R=5nm, T=300K. Contains fields 'wrinkles_present' (boolean) and 'wavelength_nm' (number or null) for each chirality.

Contact stiffness values for each GNR geometry (convex, concave, planar) and chirality (armchair, zigzag). Columns: geometry, chirality, contact_stiffness_Nm (N/m). Each row corresponds to one configuration at R=5nm, T=300K, v=10m/s.

output_contract.notes: Only the two outputs above are scored. The force_displacement.csv intermediate is not scored but serves as evidence that the nanoindentation simulation was executed.

steps.description: Check contact stiffness values, ordering trends, and zigzag/armchair ratio
